description: Defines the EmployeeDeletedEvent class which is an event class used in the orangehrmPimPlugin to represent the deletion of an employee, storing employee numbers and extending a base Event class.

classes.name: EmployeeDeletedEvent
classes.description: An event class representing the deletion of employees, holding an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the event with an array of employee numbers.

methods.name: getEmpNumbers
methods.description: Returns the array of employee numbers associated with the event.
